scope: M1 offline C0/C1 only; M2/M3 and Actor optimizer not authorized

original_M1.data: at most128 existing R03 complete trajectories; no new task/H label
original_M1.fit_parents: the previous33 fixed fit physical parents
original_M1.validation_reserve_rule: before approval select16 by SHA256(11622026|R04-validation|physical_key) from the46 R03 training parents outside previous50 calibration parents; metadata selection only, never outcomes
original_M1.validation_scope: new offline calibration holdout only; these remain historical SL/DRL-seen parents, not unseen-scene evidence
original_M1.coverage_failure_policy: if fixed reserve lacks registered size/phase coverage, report insufficient; do not replace parents or read sealed data
original_M1.initialization: same fixed net tensors; physical outputs differ between raw and normalized semantics; evaluate step0 and do not claim pure gradient-scale causation
original_M1.loss: C0 original per-state0.5 component normalized squared error; C1 equivalent normalized-unit loss; prospective fitting uses state_SUM per trajectory then episode_mean to match R03 and proposed PPO. Reported MSE remains state_mean within each aggregation. Prior offline state_MEAN results remain historical and are not relabelled.
original_M1.constant_condition: window_width,height and observable v[256] remaining_fraction four bins; never final trajectory length/H/validation targets
original_M1.constant_estimation: fit parents equal, trajectories equal, state mean; freeze before validation; unknown bins fallback fit-global
original_M1.uncertainty: paired physical-parent resampling,20000 draws, PCG64 seed11622026; states never treated independent
original_M1.go_gate: both value MSE point ratios <=0.95 versus conditional constant and paired95% upper bounds <1; both improve C0; no normalized component versus C0 ratio>1.10; each size >=3 reserve parents and value point ratio<=1 versus conditional reference
original_M1.stop: nonfinite/leakage/schema failure immediately; at128 both aggregations >1.25 conditional constant stops paired block; at256 failure means stop, no extra steps or configs

selection: 64 fit records: fixed33 parent roundrobin, withinparent SHA256(seed|R04-M1-trajectory|request_id). 16 reserve parents selected by exact R04-validation hash from46outsideprevious50; eachreserve x4sizes one smallest trajectory hash, missingcells not replaced.
input_recovery: Full268 tensors were not saved; restore exact saved prefixes with accurate frozen SL and immutable existing inputs; no new action/task/navigation/H. Persist reconstructed features for reproducibility.
clock: Cumulative active registration + engineering + saved-input reads/restoration + fit/evaluation/save/recheck process wall; code authoring and Git transport are separate maintenance, never reset prior consumption
midpoint_rule: At128 C1 value MSE / fit-only conditional constant >1.25 in BOTH state_pooled and parent_equal stops BOTH arms. C0 error alone does not terminate C1.
per_size_rule: Each of10x10,4x3,6x6,8x8 >=3 reserve physicalparents; C1value/conditional<=1 in BOTH aggregations
component_rule: Each normalizedL,K,H C1/C0<=1.10 in BOTH aggregations
initialization: Same default fresh network tensors, seed11622026; no target-informed bias. Physical prediction differs due only to output units.
normalization: fixed initial taskcount n>0; no empirical normalization fitted on either fold
engineering: Zero-step unit tests and exact actual endpoint Critic/Adam/RNG/cursor/accounting save/load; no duplicate optimizer attempts, no Actor transaction/G2 claim
